entities.summary: Matti Akseli Kuusi was a Finnish folklorist, paremiographer and paremiologist. He wrote several books and a number of articles on Finnish folklore. He was the first to have introduced the type system of proverbs similar to the Aarne–Thompson classification system of folklore, the Matti Kuusi international type system of proverbs. With encouragement from Archer Taylor he founded the journal Proverbium: Bulletin d'Information sur les Recherches Parémiologiques, published from 1965 to 1975 by the Society for Finnish Literature, which was later restarted as Proverbium: International Yearbook of Proverb Scholarship.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: Matti Kuusi's work on proverbs and paremiology contributed to the development of a systematic approach to folklore classification, influencing scholarship in the field. His journal Proverbium published important research and helped establish a global community of scholars focused on proverb studies.
